src/DoctrineTransactionRunner.php.message: Mutation detected on a local reference to a shared service ($manager). Risk of State Leak in a worker.
src/DoctrineTransactionRunner.php.reason: run() attaches its own per-run RunObserver to the entity manager's event manager and removes it in the finally block of the same try, so the listener never outlives the call, whatever the outcome (tests/Unit/DoctrineTransactionRunnerTest.php; docs/USAGE.md).
